outcomes.question: Raiders vs. Patriots: 1H Moneyline

raw_market.question: Raiders vs. Patriots: 1H Moneyline
raw_market.description:
In the first half of the NFL game between Raiders and Patriots, scheduled for October 11 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Raiders" if the Raiders outscore the Patriots in the first half.

This market will resolve to "Patriots" if the Patriots outscore the Raiders in the first half.

If both teams score the same number of points in the first half, this market will resolve 50-50.

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
